data.name: Mantis Blade
data.description: Intelligent; LE; Ego 16; Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 14; Senses 60 ft, darkvision; Telepathy; Special Purpose-slay all; 1/day when wounding a creature, the wielder can activate the Bane special ability as a swift action (only against the creature type wounded, lasts 10 min)
